C0639.title: Singles' Day Cart-Stuffing Returns Increase Merchant Operating Burden
C0639.summary: After the 2024 Singles' Day shopping festival, a The Paper Paike article reported that cart-stuffing returns created operating burdens for e-commerce sellers and cited media reports that Ralph Lauren had high Taobao Singles' Day transaction volume but a 95% return rate. The report explained that consumers add high-priced products to meet discount thresholds and then return them after payment, while merchants may bear waybill, warehouse, courier, and operating costs.
